name: ourcommunityrituals-workspace
description: Workspace root for OCR shared packages (packages/*). Sibling app repos (OSE, OW, OA, OER, OSM, OSG, OSP, OSR, OCR-docs) are independent git repos and NOT part of this workspace.

scripts.mutation:flags: cd packages/flags && stryker run && node ../../scripts/ci/mutation-file-floor.mjs reports/mutation/mutation.json
scripts.mutation:flags:integration: cd packages/flags && stryker run stryker.integration.conf.mjs && node ../../scripts/ci/mutation-file-floor.mjs reports/mutation-integration/mutation.json --floors mutation-floors.integration.json
scripts.mutation:tokens: cd packages/tokens && stryker run && node ../../scripts/ci/mutation-file-floor.mjs reports/mutation/mutation.json
scripts.mutation:ui: cd packages/ui && stryker run && node ../../scripts/ci/mutation-file-floor.mjs reports/mutation/mutation.json
